denominator.method: Enumerate every static id-bearing HTML element, every literal addEventListener registration site in app/effects, every top-level named public function and every existing test title. Counts are evidence inventory, not a completeness score.

listenerSites.registration: control.value = driver.control; control.addEventListener('change', () => { driver.control = control.value; race.cars[index].control = control.value; });

$('add-driver').addEventListener('click', () => { if (drivers.length < 4) { drivers.push({ name: ['You', 'Atlas', 'Nova', 'Ember'][drivers.length], control: 'human' }); buildRace(); renderDriverSettings(); render(); } });
$('focus-car').addEventListener('click', () => { renderer.focus(playback ? sampleReplay(recording, playback.time).cars[0] : activeCar(), true); updateCamera(); });
$('overview').addEventListener('click', () => { renderer.fit(); updateCamera(); notify('Whole track · Follow returns to your car.'); });
$('replay-speed').addEventListener('change', event => { if (playback) { playback.speed = Number(event.target.value); playback.last = 0; renderPlayback(); } });
canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', event => { event.preventDefault(); lost = true; canvas.hidden = true; canvas.dataset.renderer = 'canvas'; });

tests.name: momentum is accumulated; coasting, braking, reverse, and diagonal moves use the same equation
wildlife crashes only a car that ends its turn on the occupied cell
AI avoids wildlife at its landing cell and checks the same braking rule
supercover includes both side cells at exact diagonal corner contact
a free destination cannot tunnel through holes, boundaries, or cars
a ramp jumps exactly one cell, including a car, then requires a clear landing
incomplete jumps and airborne boundary crossings crash; wrong-way ramps do not launch
crashes advance to the last safe cell and never stop the other car
every crash imposes three driving turns at grid speed one, with no skipped turns
clear road paths do not crash; a distant boundary stops the car near that boundary
AI drives during the speed restriction and never chooses a disabled acceleration
generated tracks are deterministic, varied, connected, and provide a straight clear starting grid
reversing over the start does not win; a legal full lap does; play ends at victory
AI rejects wall-bounce shortcuts and retains a safe stopping route
AI finishes seeded races without using crashes as a strategy
four AI drivers share the road and finish without intentionally colliding
cars face their exact travel vector and retain heading at rest, after crashes and during recovery
scenery motion leaves track geometry and parked cars unchanged
only grounded wildlife occupies landing cells; walking onto a parked car never causes a crash
birds rest, take off, fly and land again, and react to approaching cars
ground wildlife crosses both ways without teleporting at cycle boundaries
replay interpolates all drivers together by round and scrubs exactly to recorded endpoints
full recording retains every turn, including crashes, jumps and recovery
playback advances by elapsed time and selected speed, clamps seeking and ends exactly
a crash translates to contact before stopping, in live animation and replay
indexed replay seeks across a long race and refreshes when more turns are recorded
all circuit length, corner and width combinations support a connected four-car start
seeds change the silhouette and settings control length, turns and width reproducibly
hidden shortcuts are optional, connected, traversable and earn only their local route progress
tire marks reveal only travelled ground and distinguish hidden grass routes
crash sparks begin at contact and effects rewind and pause deterministically
effects respect reduced motion and bound particles and persistent marks
cosmetic effects never change cars, collision surfaces or progress
tire burn requires acceleration or sharp-turn friction, never ordinary braking or coasting
hidden paths leave surface effects while futuristic trails honor selected neon colors
every world has distinct deterministic crash and hidden-path effects independent of wall-clock time

worlds.name: Forest
worlds.subtitle: Woodland trails
worlds.description: Pines, wildflowers and cool woodland ponds. Birds perch on the road; deer wander between the trees.

worlds.name: Desert
worlds.subtitle: Sun & sandstone
worlds.description: Warm sand, rippling dunes, cacti and sandstone. Desert birds circle overhead while lizards dash across the road.

worlds.name: Futuristic
worlds.subtitle: Neon after dark
worlds.description: A midnight circuit lined with neon towers and glowing gardens. Scout drones land, recharge and lift off; tiny service rovers patrol the road.

worlds.name: Jungle
worlds.subtitle: Lost canopy
worlds.description: Race through giant palms and ancient ruins. Parrots and lizards share the road. Hidden trails leave muddy ruts and leaves; impacts throw up a burst of foliage.

worlds.name: Sky
worlds.subtitle: Above the clouds
worlds.description: Floating roads above a sea of clouds, with gulls and tiny cloud creatures. Hidden routes leave white vapor trails; impacts scatter frost and cloud puffs.

worlds.name: Sea
worlds.subtitle: Tidal circuit
worlds.description: Cross ocean platforms between tropical islets and buoys. Gulls and crabs wander nearby. Hidden channels leave foamy wakes; impacts erupt in spray and bubbles.

worlds.name: Space
worlds.subtitle: Orbital drift
worlds.description: An orbital circuit among stars, ringed planets and asteroids. Probes and rovers patrol the deck. Hidden routes leave violet plasma trails; impacts release drifting ion sparks.
